deleteDialog.title: Delete {child}?
deleteDialog.body: The profile and everything you filled in about this child will be deleted. This can't be undone.

childFiles.title: {child}'s history
childFiles.subtitle: Activities, photos and medical tests in the order they happened — and only you can see them.

examNotice.title: A medical test is your child's health data
examNotice.body: The file is encrypted before it leaves your phone and only your account can open it. No one on the team, no ad and no artificial intelligence reads the test. Deleting it here deletes it from the server too.
examNotice.consent: I understand and I want to save my child's medical test here.
examNotice.reminder: It stays encrypted and it stays yours — deleting it here deletes it from the server.

usage.title: Storage used
usage.fileMax: Each file can be up to {size}.
usage.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than {size}. Choose a smaller one.
usage.childQuota: This child's album has no room for this file. Delete something to make room.
usage.accountQuota: Your account has no room for this file. Delete something to make room.
